notes.status: PROTOTYPE, UNAUDITED. Nothing is deployed. The owner deploys; never an agent.
notes.contract: contracts/stable/BridgedStablecoinV3.sol, byte-identical to the Ethereum bridge's launch token (creation code keccak 0xe560441f37e247e387cebd23bb3dd798a29d34174a9fb19a4bb3877c6c721de7); only constructor arguments differ
notes.tool: tools/deploy-pontes/deploy_pontes.py takes this file as it takes deployments/mainnet/busdc-mainnet.config.json. The `stellar` section (in place of `ethereum`) selects the Stellar source path, tools/deploy-pontes/source_stellar.py: validate, plan, run --source-rpc <own Stellar RPC> (refuses a used vault), record, verify --source-rpc (Wasm hash, route, cap, committee, guardians, release delay, fee address and the mint-chain genesis read from the vault's ledger entries)
notes.source: sourceChainId is the Stellar network id (sha256 of the network passphrase) as a uint256, derived by the tool; sourceVault is the low 20 bytes of the vault's contract id, derived by the tool; stellar.route is the DEPLOYED vault's route (tools/signatario-stellar/pairing.py args prints it)
notes.committee: the same 7 `l2-mint-signer` and 3 `l2-token-guardian` keys as bUSDC (EIP-712 binds the token address, so a signature for one token is not valid for another); stellar.vaultSigners are the 7 `eth-release-signer` addresses and stellar.vaultGuard.guardians the 3 `eth-vault-guardian` addresses of docs/BRIDGE-V3-KEY-CEREMONY.md, each list strictly ascending
notes.limits: as bUSDC: T = 0 (every mint waits 12 h and is cancellable), bucket 10,000 a day, cap 100,000, minBurn 10. supplyCap must equal the vault cap and bucketCapacity the vault window limit
notes.releaseDelay: stellar.releaseDelay and stellar.largeReleaseThreshold must equal the deployed vault's; the values here are the PROPOSAL of deployments/stellar/busdc-xlm-vault.config.json (owner decision, docs/STELLAR-BRIDGE.md section 5)
notes.router: contracts/stellar/StellarBurnRouter.sol is deployed after the token, with the token as its only argument; it has no power
notes.l2Build: L2 deposit-only launch build: release bloch-l2-2026-11-03-next-native-78d4921c, bloch-l2-evm build commit `926d2cf` against native 78d4921c (follower cdf5da5c, produce-dev e3f1a290, settled-rpc 53e88565; SHA256SUMS 6d3bd628, the owner's signing target); network.genesisHash = the pinned L2 genesis 632e45ae
